BiblicalUsage: Pedahel appears once, named as the prince of Naphtali, the son of Ammihud, chosen to divide the land of Canaan among the tribes. His name means God has redeemed, and his one recorded act is standing in the company of the princes who portioned out the inheritance.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God names the men who do the quiet work of dividing the inheritance fairly, and Pedahel's single verse is enough to remember him by.
